IT Technical Specialist

What you will do

Translate needs into design. Work with partners and hospital end-users to understand what they need, then turn it into technical specifications and integration designs — selecting the technologies, defining data flows and interfaces, and building in scalability and security from the start.

Integrate the systems. Configure and develop interfaces between medical devices, our IT solutions and hospital information systems — including the Neuro application, HiQ and its patient monitor plugin, the Polaris ECG data management system, and Tele-ICU solutions.

Get the data right. Define the data mappings and transformations so information moves between systems accurately and consistently, including cleansing, validation and enrichment.

Test, deploy and document. Build and run integration test plans against performance, security and reliability standards. Oversee deployment into live hospital environments without interrupting operations, and document architectures, data flows and troubleshooting guides properly.

Own the projects. Plan and coordinate integration projects from first inspection through to completion — timelines, resources and delivery.

Keep it running, and bring people with you. Resolve technical issues after go-live, monitor integrated systems for performance and security, and train partners and end-users so they can manage the solutions confidently.

What you will bring

• At least three years in IT systems integration, ideally in healthcare or with medical devices

• Network configuration to CCNA level or equivalent

• SQL databases, Citrix environments and VMware

• HL7 and hospital information system integration

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with sound judgement under pressure

• Real project management capability — planning, organising, and seeing work through to completion

• Comfortable working independently and as part of a team spread across countries and time zones

Helpful, though not essential

• Familiarity with clinical devices — patient monitors, ECG, defibrillators, EEG and other neurology equipment

• Experience deploying into live hospital environments

• Exposure to Tele-ICU or remote patient monitoring solutions

About Nihon Kohden Middle East

Nihon Kohden is a Japanese medical technology company. Our regional office in Jebel Ali Free Zone supports distribution partners and hospitals across the Gulf, the Levant, Türkiye, Pakistan and Africa, across patient monitoring, ECG, defibrillation, neurology, ventilation and in-vitro diagnostics. The systems you build here are used in clinical care.

The details

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Employment type: Full-time, on-site

Reporting to: Senior Manager, Service

Expected start: September or October 2026

Applications close: 14 September 2026

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or send your CV to recruitment@nkme.ae

Nihon Kohden Middle East FZE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or disability.

Job Summary/Objective

The Managed Services Support Specialist – ManageEngine is responsible for proactively managing, maintaining, and supporting ManageEngine tools deployed at client environments. The role ensures service continuity, tool optimization, IT asset visibility, and alignment with ITIL best practices, enabling clients to operate efficiently and meet strategic IT goals.

Key Responsibilities:

• ManageEngine Administration & Monitoring

• Proactively manage and operate covered ManageEngine products (e.g., ServiceDesk Plus, OpManager) based on vendor standards.

• Monitor product performance and health to detect and resolve issues before they impact operations.

• Apply configuration changes and system updates to reflect evolving business and operational requirements.

• Track and apply ManageEngine release notes, patches, and enhancements to maintain system currency and stability.

• Vendor Communication & Product Updates

• Coordinate with ManageEngine support to resolve technical issues and understand upcoming changes or features.

• Stay informed on product roadmaps and enhancements to advise on potential optimizations.

• Roadmap Contribution & Alignment with Business Goals

• Assist in the creation of product roadmaps and improvement plans that align with broader IT initiatives and client projects.

• Recommend enhancements to the ManageEngine environment to meet future operational needs.

• Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and process flows with version control.

• Develop and manage a knowledge base to support Help Desk operations and troubleshooting.

• Training & Enablement

• Deliver targeted training sessions to client personnel (e.g., Help Desk, Service Desk) to build operational knowledge.

• Provide guides and materials to ensure proper onboarding and use of the system.

• IT Asset & Configuration Management

• Manage and update asset inventories to ensure accuracy and availability of infrastructure records.

• Generate regular asset reports for stakeholders to support technology refresh plans.

• Alert the client for upcoming license and support renewals to ensure uninterrupted service.

• Change Management Compliance

• Adhere to and participate in the formal Change Management process for system modifications.

• Assess change impact, update documentation, and obtain approvals as per policy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Monitor cybersecurity platforms, dashboards, alerts, and operational activities

• Maintain security documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and operational reports
• Collaborate with security teams, infrastructure teams, and vendors for issue resolution

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field

• Hands-on experience with:

• SOAR platforms (Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or similar)
• VPN technologies (IPSec / SSL VPN)
• Security monitoring and incident response
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity operations, threat detection, and log analysis
• Experience with ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management
• Knowledge of SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, NCA ECC, PDPL, and NDMO is preferred
• Basic scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell, or similar) is preferred
